newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag sees E2 break-even within five years.
newsitem.headline: Viag sees E2 break-even within five years.

text.p: Viag chairman Georg Obermeier said on Thursday he expected the E2 mobile phone network, for which Viag plans to bid, to break even within five years of its start.
Viag's telecommunications director Maximilian Ardelt added that the network would have annual turnover of between five and six billion marks within 10 years.
Obermeier told reporters that, as of now, he believed that Viag was the only company planning to bid for the E2 licence, Germany's fourth.
Bids must be lodged with the German government by October 15, and the licence will be awarded on February 4, 1997.
